name: repo-tooling
//: The repository's own tooling scripts: setup and the session hook, the Nx wrapper and gate plumbing (nx, nx-base.sh, bun.sh), the actionlint installer and workflow lint the ci-workflows project runs, install.sh (the README's published installer URL, so it stays here), and the release probe (named by release-targets.toml, so it stays here), with their offline journeys. It depends on llmlint because the justfile, .claude/ and the other repo-root files these scripts and journeys read belong to the root project.

test.//: Offline journeys over the scripts here (the actionlint installer and workflow lint, the readiness check, the gate recipes' base selection) and the agent allowlist. Cached: its inputs are every file they read or run.
